minor.comment: Qualifier-name-typed declarations: the resource and condition declaration types take an optional `TQualifierNames` parameter (default `string`), and matching `typed*` converters such as `ResourceJson.Convert.typedResourceTreeRootDecl(qualifierNameConverter)` validate qualifier names at load time.
Importers accept `fileContentConverter` and `fileContentExtensions`, so resource files in another format — YAML, for example — can be imported.

`QualifierCollector.create` accepts qualifier names as plain strings alongside full declarations (`qualifierTypes` is optional when every entry is a string), and the simple context qualifier providers accept partial `qualifierValues`.

patch.comment: Packaging: `CAPABILITIES.md` and source maps now ship in the package; test helper files no longer do.

major.comment: Upgrading from 5.0.2: `ResourceJson.Json.ConditionSetDeclAsRecord` is now readonly and partial. Code that builds one by assigning keys one at a time must build a `Record<string, …>` and assign it whole.
Upgrading from 5.0.2: `QualifierCollector`'s protected constructor now takes `(qualifierTypes, qualifiers?)` instead of `(params)`; a subclass calling `super(params)` must pass the two values.
